title: 第25章 买东西狠狠的买第26章 沈家老爷的邀请
slug: 我能给箭术加点从猎户到斩仙
content_zh:
“四十文。”
李玄答道。
年轻媳妇吸了口气，显然觉得贵了。
“能……能便宜点不？三十五文行吗？我婆婆病着，就想喝口鲜鱼汤……”
旁边有人搭腔：“小嫂子，这冰下的活水鱼，这季节可稀罕，四十文不贵啦！”
李玄看了看她怀里的孩子和恳切的眼神，语气缓和了些：
“大嫂，这鱼确实肥，没土腥气，最是养人。
这样，四十文，我再搭您两根品相好的黄精须子，您和鱼一起炖，汤更补，对老人身子好。
您看行不？”
年轻媳妇眼睛亮了一下，黄精也是好东西。
她犹豫片刻，这才笑着点头，仔细数出四十枚铜钱，递给李玄：
“那就要这条吧。
谢谢你了，小兄弟。”
“您拿好。”
李玄接过钱，利落地用草绳穿过鱼鳃提起来递过去。
又顺手从药材堆里捡了两根细长的黄精须子给她。
李忠和嫂子起初还有些发懵，但见李玄应对自如，买卖开张，也渐渐放松下来。
王氏机灵地帮着收钱、找零，李忠则负责将药材分门别类摆好。
有人问时，便憨厚地介绍这是自家山坡上种的，保证没熏硫。
最后，小半个时辰过去。

摊子上的东西就卖的七七八八了。
黄精卖了大概一百五十文，茯苓卖了近百文。
加上卖鱼所得，两条四十，两条三十五，一条三十，一条三十五，加上最后两条打包七十文，共计二百八十五文。
以及羊皮的七百文，这一趟赶集，足足进账了一千二百多文，折合银子约一两二钱有余！
这对往日穷困的李家来说，简直是一笔巨款！
王氏小心翼翼地将沉甸甸的铜钱和碎银子收好。
手都有些发抖，脸上是抑制不住的激动红光。
李忠也是喜笑颜开，盘算着能买多少粮食、盐巴。
“走，嫂子，大哥，咱去买东西，狠狠的买！”
揣着那一千二百多文沉甸甸的收获，李家人脸上的喜气几乎要溢出来。
王氏紧紧捂着装钱的褡裢，手指隔着粗布都能感觉到铜钱的坚实，心里是从未有过的踏实。
她先领着兄弟俩直奔粮米铺子。
“掌柜的，上好的糙米，来一斗！
白面……也来半斗！”
content_en:
"Forty Wen."
Li Xuan replied.
The young wife took a breath, obviously feeling it was expensive.
"Can...can it be cheaper? Thirty-five cents? My mother-in-law is sick and just wants to drink fresh fish soup..."
Someone next to me said, "Sister-in-law, these living fish under the ice are rare in this season. Forty coins are not expensive!"
Li Xuan looked at the child in her arms and her sincere eyes, and softened his tone:
“Sister-in-law, this fish is indeed fat, has no earthy smell, and is the most nourishing fish.
In this way, for forty coins, I will give you two good-quality polygonatum beards, and you will stew them with the fish. The soup will be more tonic and good for the elderly.
Do you think it will work? "
The young wife's eyes lit up, Huang Jing was also a good thing.
She hesitated for a moment, then nodded with a smile, carefully counted out forty copper coins, and handed them to Li Xuan:
“Then take this one.
Thank you, little brother. "
"Take it."
Li Xuan took the money, neatly passed it through the gills of the fish with a straw rope, lifted it up and handed it over.
Then he picked up two slender Huangjing whiskers from the pile of medicinal materials and gave them to her.
Li Zhong and his sister-in-law were a little confused at first, but they gradually relaxed when they saw that Li Xuan was able to cope with the situation easily and the business was open.
Wang cleverly helped collect the money and make change, while Li Zhong was responsible for arranging the medicinal materials into categories.
When someone asked, he honestly introduced that it was grown on his own hillside and was guaranteed not to be fumed with sulfur.
Finally, half an hour passed.
The items on the stall were sold at high prices.
Huang Jing was sold for about 150 renminbi, and Poria cocos was sold for nearly 100 renminbi.
Including the proceeds from selling the fish, two were forty, two were thirty-five, one was thirty, and one was thirty-five, plus the last two were packaged for seventy cents, for a total of two hundred and eighty-five cents.
As well as 700 cash for sheepskin, this trip to the market brought in more than 1,200 cash, which is equivalent to about one or two taels of silver!
This was a huge sum of money for the formerly poor Li family!
Mrs. Wang carefully put away the heavy copper coins and broken silver.
His hands were shaking a little, and his face was red with uncontrollable excitement.
Li Zhong was also smiling, thinking about how much grain and salt he could buy.
"Let's go, sister-in-law, brother, let's go shopping and buy hard!"
With the heavy harvest of more than 1,200 yuan, the joy on the faces of the Li family almost overflowed.
Mrs. Wang tightly held the bag containing the money, her fingers could feel the solidity of the copper coins through the coarse cloth, and she felt more at ease than ever before.
She first led the two brothers straight to the grain and rice shop.
“Shopkeeper, here’s a bucketful of fine brown rice!
White noodles... also come for half a fight! "
